meta.name: writing-guidelines
meta.description: Review docs/prose for Writing Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my docs", "check writing style", "audit prose", "review docs voice and tone", or "check this page against the writing handbook".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查文档是否符合写作规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保文档遵循统一的写作指南
copy.tagline_en: Check docs for writing guidelines compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure docs follow a writing handbook

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会从指定网址获取最新写作规范，然后检查你指定的文件是否符合这些规范，最后以“文件名:行号”的简洁格式输出不合规的地方。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude“检查我的文档”、“检查写作风格”、“审查文章”或“对照写作手册检查这个页面”时触发。

say.text: 检查我的文档是否符合写作规范。
say.note: Claude 会要求你指定文件，然后进行审查。

say.text: 审查这个页面的写作风格。
say.note: Claude 会获取最新规范并检查当前页面。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude fetches the latest writing guidelines from a specified URL, checks your specified files against those rules, and outputs non-compliant findings in a concise 'file:line' format.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to 'review my docs', 'check writing style', 'audit prose', or 'check this page against the writing handbook'.

say_en.text: Check my document against the writing guidelines.
say_en.note: Claude will ask you to specify the file, then review it.

say_en.text: Audit the writing style of this page.
say_en.note: Claude fetches the latest rules and checks the current page.
